children: Mellody Hobson will open the Lucas Museum of Narrative Art in Los Angeles on September 22 with her husband, as the privately funded project cost roughly $1 billion. Hobson co-chairs the museum’s board and also sits on the JPMorgan Chase board and its risk committee, according to BeInCrypto, while JPMorgan’s Kinexys blockchain unit has processed more than $3 trillion and now averages over $5 billion in daily volume.

title: Mellody Hobson Opens $1 Billion Lucas Museum In Los Angeles
